Using the MaxCLL in this way helps improve the appearance because typically the MaxCLL value is lower than the maximum luminance of the mastering display, which leads to less extreme tone mapping. If the MaxCLL is less than the viewing display’s maximum luminance, then no tone mapping is necessary.
